representation: strict Decimal text / Decimal / exact integer
explicit_rounding_policy: no hidden pre-grade rounding; governing Rule only

display_policy.authority: presentation only; MUST NOT feed authoritative grade/rule/bucket comparison

normalization_policy: Q/H remain total inputs; Pump-specific suction/stage transforms follow approved Pump contract and PUMP-RP-0.1

trace_reference.rule_trace: EvaluationResult.standard_reference / lookup and trace rule data_ids
trace_reference.note: Numeric Contract v1 permits an equivalent immutable trace/reference structure. This adoption does not introduce a new Result schema field while public Result/Record field placement remains separately governed.

other_device_policy: Transformer, motor, fan and future calculators do not inherit Decimal50. Each authoritative calculator scope declares its own Numeric Profile based on its evidence and governing rules.
